listing.title: Dachshund Mug, Watercolor Wiener Dog Coffee Mug, Floral All Over Print, Dachshund Mom Gift, Doxie Lover Mug, Cute Dog Mug
listing.description: Little dachshunds in red, black and tan, chocolate and cream trot all the way around the mug among watercolor roses, daisies, wildflowers, eucalyptus and tiny hearts, on a warm cream background.
